title: English Practice Quiz 0429
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correct plural of 'child'.
questions.explanation: Children is the irregular plural of child.

questions.question: If it rains, we ___ indoors.
questions.explanation: The first conditional uses if + present simple, will + base verb.

questions.question: This is the woman ___ helped me.
It ___ rain later; take an umbrella.
The weather can ___ your travel plans.
questions.explanation: Affect is usually a verb meaning to influence.

questions.question: There ___ two chairs in the room.
questions.explanation: Use are with the plural noun chairs.

questions.question: ___ I borrow your pen, please?
questions.explanation: May is a polite way to ask permission.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I like tea, coffee and milk.
I like tea coffee and milk
I like, tea coffee, and milk.
i like tea, coffee and milk
questions.explanation: Use commas to separate items in a list and capitalise the first word.

questions.question: I want ___ English fluently.
questions.explanation: Want is followed by a to-infinitive.
